It boasts additional armor to protect the horse's head and neck.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Knight's Bridle is a type of [[Bridle]] that can be obtained by [[Jini]] at the [[Mounted Archery Camp]]. It is given when [[Link]] breaks 20-22 targets during the [[Horseback Archery]] [[Mini-Game]].{{Cite|Tell you what... You break {{Color BotW|Red|more than 20}} targets, and I'll hand over my {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}}.|Jini|BotW}}{{Cite|Hm...{{Color BotW|Red|[X] targets}}... You've got some fire in you, young man. The best archers say {{Color BotW|Red|targets seem to freeze when they concentrate on them}}. I think you could reach that level too. Here's a gift to help you on your travels. Hope you find a good use for it.|Jini|BotW}} Before the [[Great Calamity]], the [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]] gave these Bridles to their [[Horse]]s. Despite claiming that they provide additional armor to a Horse's head and neck, it is purely cosmetic. The Knight's Bridle belong to the [[Knight's Gear]] set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} Workers at [[Highland Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], and [[Woodland Stable]] are able to equip Link's Horses with the Knight's Bridle.{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Knight's Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, they are unable to be placed on [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== The Knight's Bridle, alongside the [[Knight's Saddle]], is obtainable by interacting with the ''[[Pony Points Ledger]]'' after collecting a total of 23 [[Pony Point]]s from [[Stable]]s.{{Cite|You'd like to get your Pony Points reward, right? For 23 points, you get a knight's saddle, aaand...|Sprinn|TotK}}
{{Cite|a knight's bridle! Here you go!|Sprinn|TotK}} Afterwards, [[Link]] is able to speak to any Stable owner to have it equipped to his current [[Horse]].{{Cite|Change to the {{Color TotK|Red|knight's bridle}}?|Sprinn|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bridle * Horse Gear * Knight's Saddle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bridles, Horse Gear, Knight's Gear |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
